problem: Improve VLA action selection by spending additional inference-time compute on candidate generation and learned verification.
contribution: RoboMonkey trains a VLM action-ranking verifier from synthetic preferences and proposes actions efficiently through a fitted distribution before selecting the highest score.
algorithm: Sample and cluster policy actions; rank pairs by RMSE to a demonstrated action. Train a LLaVA7B reward head with Bradley-Terry and preference-margin loss. At inference fit a Gaussian to sampled translation/rotation, majority-vote the gripper state, resample candidates and choose the verifier maximum.
observations: Current visual state, task language and candidate action. RMSE-to-demonstration supervision is a preference proxy, not observed physical task success or a calibrated safety certificate.
actions: Selected Cartesian pose increment plus gripper state from a generalist policy proposal distribution; candidate sampling is not repeated physical trial execution.
embodiment_and_data: BridgeV2over40Ktrajectories and20Msynthetic comparisons; OpenVLA base and LLaVA verifier, trained with8H100s. Reported deployment uses28GBGPUmemory and about1.5Hz on oneH100.
experiments: SIMPLER in-distribution, physical WidowX OOD tasks and further transfer/verification ablations. Real prose specifies4task suites×10trials per approach and120total rollouts across compared approaches, not120independent trials per policy.
baselines: OpenVLA and V-GPS with corresponding verifier checkpoints; test-time sampling and training-size/component ablations. Extra verifier computation changes the deployed resource budget.

quantitative_result.value: Physical OOD average60%RoboMonkey versus35%OpenVLA and30%V-GPS. Per-method40trials follows4×10in the protocol; source total120covers three compared approaches. This is a particular WidowX study, not Explorer verification accuracy.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p7 Section5.3; compute contract p6 Section5.1

limitations: Substantial inference overhead,20Mcomparison/Bridge-focused training and limited embodiment scope. Single-demonstration RMSE can under-reward valid alternative actions; a learned score does not prove contact/grip/world-effect correctness.
code_and_license: Primary method/evaluation examined; executable repository, checkpoints and separate model/data licenses not audited here. No local RoboMonkey execution is claimed.
hardware_adaptation: A research comparison for ranking, with abstention and measured false-positive outcomes. The source28GBdeployment exceeds16GBdevice memory; do not substitute a generic VLM score for the controller's evidence and safety authority.
